business_summary: Cscec Scimee Sci.&Tech. Co.,Ltd manufactures and sells environmental protection equipment and services in China. The company operates through Water treatment business, Centrifuge Business, and Municipal Wastewater Business segments. It offers technology platforms for coagulation separation, filtration separation, biochemical treatment, hydraulic fluid dynamics, heat exchange, and centrifugal separation. The company also provides magnetic separation, magnetic sedimentation, perforated plate grids, magnetic biochemistry, centrifugal dewatering, and sludge drying. In addition, it engages in industrial water environment treatment, municipal and watershed water environment treatment, and the research and development of centrifuge products; as well as development, production, and sales. The company was formerly known as Scimee Sci.&Tech. Co.,Ltd and changed its name to Cscec Scimee Sci.&Tech. Co.,Ltd in October 2019. Cscec Scimee Sci.&Tech. Co.,Ltd was founded in 2002 and is based in Chengdu, China.
